about.Бұл коммерциялық емес жоба. Ол тұрғындар: This is a non-profit project. It helps residents understand air quality: for example, it shows where the hydrogen sulfide smell in Atyrau comes from and how wind direction and speed affect it.
about.Қала картасында әр бекеттің өлшемдері, ж: The city map shows each station’s readings, the wind and a comparison with limit values. The page about gases explains what each substance is, how it is measured and how it affects health.

about.Бұл ресми ескерту емес. Көрсетілген көзд: This is not an official warning. The sources and colours shown are a model estimate; official data on actual pollution comes from the monitoring stations themselves. Nor is this medical advice: if you feel worse, call 103 or see a doctor.

city.Есептеу — Гаусс шлейфі моделі (атмосфера: The calculation uses a Gaussian plume model (atmospheric dispersion): for each source, given that hour’s wind, atmospheric stability and release height, it estimates how much reaches each station and how fast, then compares this with the actual measurement.

Stations — the Kazhydromet map (ecodata.kz), hourly. Wind, solar radiation and cloud cover — Open-Meteo, city centre (47.11, 51.92).
city.Бір сан ≥6 сағат қатарынан өзгермесе (мә: If one value stays the same for ≥6 hours in a row (value ≥ 6) and does not move at all within ±12 hours, it is marked as “stuck” (⚠) and excluded from the analysis.
city.Тексерілді: осындай 5 мәннің бәрі AirKz: Checked: all 5 such values are not shown in the AirKz app. Stations with a CO median < 10 have a doubtful unit (possibly mg/m³) and are excluded from the analysis.
city.ҚР ДСМ-70 бұйрығы (02.08.2022), 1-қосымш: Order No. ҚР ДСМ-70 (02.08.2022), Annex 1 — maximum one-time limit. Stations report hourly values, so the comparison is approximate.
city.Көзден шыққан газ жел бойымен тарап, кең: Gas from the source spreads downwind and widens; the ground-level concentration is:
city., мұнда y — жел осінен қашықтық, H — шығ: , where y is the distance from the wind axis, H the release height and u the wind at that height.
city.• Атмосфера тұрақтылығы — Пасквилл–Гиффо: • Atmospheric stability — Pasquill–Gifford classes A–F (from wind speed, solar radiation and night-time cloud cover).
city.• Сағат ішінде жел бағыты ±15° ауытқиды: • Within an hour the wind direction is assumed to vary by ±15° (a wider plume).
city.• Биіктік маңызды: жердегі көз жақын маң: • Height matters: a ground-level source gives a high concentration nearby, especially on a calm night; the plume of a tall stack reaches the ground farther away.
city.• Тоған (Сасық сай) — пішіні OpenStreetM: • The pond (Sasyk Sai) — its shape comes from OpenStreetMap, with a 1 km grid inside; the release is split equally among the points (the nearest edge is also taken into account).
city.Құбырдан шыққан газ ауадан жылы болса, к: If the gas leaving a stack is warmer than the air, it rises (Briggs):
city.және тұрақты түнде 2,6·(F/(u·S))<sup>⅓</: and does not exceed 2.6·(F/(u·S))<sup>⅓</sup> on a stable night, otherwise 21.4·F<sup>¾</sup>/u (F < 55) or 38.7·F<sup>0.6</sup>/u. F is the buoyancy flux (stack diameter, gas velocity, difference between gas and air temperature).
city.Құбыр параметрлері — НДВ-дан (қазір АТЭЦ: Stack parameters come from the emission limits documents (currently ATPP No. 4 and No. 2); for the refinery flare the gas temperature is unknown, so no rise is calculated.
city.Ауа температурасы — көзге жақын Қазгидро: Air temperature — values from Kazhydromet stations near the source (weighted by 1/d²), or Open-Meteo if there are none. Single-level measurements are not enough to detect an inversion, so the stability class is still derived from wind, radiation and cloud cover.
city.Әр бекеттің өз фонынан (медиана) артық м: Each station’s excess over its own background (median) is taken. For each source the model works out what pattern the stations would show if that source were responsible,
city.ең кіші квадраттар әдісімен сәйкестендір: and matches it to the real pattern by least squares. The result is the share of the excess that the source explains. Below 25% — “source not identified”; 25–50% — a weak signal (the list is shown, no outline on the map). If the excess is below 3 µg/m³, no source search is done at all (ecodata rounds values to integers, so a small difference is noise).
city.Тексерілді: жасанды шығарылыммен 10 тест: Tested: 10 tests with an artificial release (the source is found; a ground-level source and a 60 m stack at the same point are told apart).
city.Көзден бекетке дейінгі қашықтық ÷ сол са: Distance from the source to the station ÷ wind speed in that hour (for the pond — from its nearest edge). A simple estimate: the air is assumed to travel in a straight line with the wind.
city.Модель «секірістерді» іздейді, ал бекет: The model looks for “jumps” and treats a constant source next to a station as background. So there is a separate check: is the station above the median of the city’s stations in ≥ 80% of the hours in the period.
city.Артық мән болған бекеттен (немесе шағым: An arrow goes from a station with an excess (or a complaint point) toward where the wind came from; the arrowhead points at the station — the wind carried the gas from the source to the station. Where the arrows meet is the possible source.
city.Бір сағатта сызықтар параллель, сондықта: Within a single hour the lines are parallel, so finding a source takes several hours during which the wind turned (3 hours by default).
city.Жел — қаланың бір нүктесінен; көздердің: Wind is from a single point in the city; the height and position of sources are assumptions (they can be edited); TCO and NCOC data are not processed.
city.Нәтиже — ықтималдық, кінәліні дәлелдеу е: The result is a probability, not proof of who is to blame.
